{{Top|leg}}
'''Lessen another's fatigue''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to relieve fatigue from another.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[block pain]], [[heal]], [[lessen another's pain]], [[lessen fatigue]], and [[speed healing]] spells.
